project.name: com.wxdgaming.batis.mongodb
project.description:
Unimplemented placeholder for a future MongoDB dialect of wxd-gaming.batis, a lightweight JDBC-first ORM for Java 21. This module currently contains no usable API, is excluded from the reactor build, and publishes no artifact. Do not depend on it; use com.wxdgaming.batis.sql.mysql or com.wxdgaming.batis.sql.pgsql instead.
wxd-gaming.batis 未来 MongoDB 方言的未实现占位模块：当前不提供任何可用 API，已从 reactor 构建中排除， 也不会发布任何产物，请勿依赖。MySQL 请用 com.wxdgaming.batis.sql.mysql， PostgreSQL 请用 com.wxdgaming.batis.sql.pgsql。
